checks.name: Q1 needs a predicate no store holds
checks.detail: 1 reaction(s) -> 3 enzymes -> 2 bacterial -> 1 Cys-free; the last step is a computation over a retrieved sequence, not a triple lookup

checks.name: Q2 is answerable only from the ELN
checks.detail: no public reaction/protein/pathway source declares 'buffer' or 'ph'; the datum exists only in the laboratory record

checks.name: Q5 matches on operator AND date AND device settings
checks.detail: instrument provenance is a first-class record, not an annotation

checks.name: Q6-Q8 form a strictly narrowing chain
checks.detail: compound C: 3 datasets -> type NMR: 2 -> Bruker at 13C: 1. Each added constraint removes at least one dataset, so the filters are shown to discriminate rather than merely to return a row

checks.name: Q8 needs device SETTINGS, not just device identity
checks.detail: restricting from 'a Bruker' to 'a Bruker set to 13C' removes a dataset; a configuration value is part of the measurement's provenance

checks.name: the same chain runs both ways in different media
checks.detail: one reaction identifier, three verdicts: cytosol_gln_depleted=forward, cytosol_og_depleted=reverse, balanced=undirected

checks.name: direction is a property of the medium, not of the chain
checks.detail: identical substrates, products and identifier; opposite verdicts

checks.name: CONTROL: a balanced medium refuses to orient
checks.detail: delta=+0.00e+00, |delta| <= beta=3.7e-04; without this the trichotomy would have an unreachable third case

checks.name: flooding a product saturates at exactly -log(1 + tau/mu0)
checks.detail: limit -2.397895 vs predicted -2.397895 (units of beta); thirty orders of magnitude of flooding move it no further

checks.name: depleting a reactant is unbounded
checks.detail: depletion reaches -22.93 beta and keeps falling, while flooding stops at -2.40 beta: reversing a chain requires depleting a reactant, not flooding a product

checks.name: identical molecules, opposite roles, decided by computation
checks.detail: w(l,m)=3.700e-04; rho_str(axial)=1.480e-03 >= w -> structural; rho_str(bulk)=0 < w -> bulk. No curator supplies this and no vocabulary term records it

checks.name: classification needs one number per catalyst and no structure
checks.detail: two enzymes from different organisms with no sequence comparison fall in one class because their powers agree

checks.name: deletion tolerance is predicted before any experiment
checks.detail: composite 0.8614; deleting rung 2 keeps 0.802, deleting rung 3 drops to 0.692 and fails the requirement

checks.name: capability containment is decided before any request is issued
checks.detail: the plan is refused statically, naming the offending step and features

checks.name: a starved step names the predecessor at fault
checks.detail: blame walk terminates at 'find_rxn', not at a step that answered correctly

checks.name: exhaustion is distinguished from emptiness
checks.detail: two steps answered, two report EXHAUSTED; a rows-only interface would have returned the same empty table for both

checks.name: non-degeneracy: no verdict but ANSWER may carry a payload
checks.detail: constructing a STARVED result with a payload raises; the property is enforced by the type, not by reporting discipline

checks.name: the system both answers and refuses
checks.detail: 21 answered, 7 refused; a system that answered everything would have an empty defined class

checks.name: every refusal names a blocker and an unblock path
checks.detail: 7/7 refusals carry both fields

checks.name: at least four distinct verdicts are reached
checks.detail: reached: ['answer', 'exhausted', 'starved', 'unexpressed', 'unsupported']
